verdict.rationale: Bugbot documents comment-based commands in the PR thread: `cursor review` or `bugbot run`, with a `verbose=true` option where Bugbot replies with a table of the rules it loaded. It also reads existing top-level and inline PR comments as context for its reviews. There is no evidence that it answers free-form developer questions or explains its findings conversationally when someone replies in a thread. missing for 10: conversational replies to developer questions in PR threads, on-demand explanations of findings, commands beyond triggering a review, independent hands-on corroboration of in-thread dialogue.

support.subject: As a developer, I reply to the reviewer in the PR thread to ask questions, get explanations, or issue commands — and it answers in context

citations.quote: Manual trigger by commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run` on any PR
Bugbot replies with a table of the rules included in that review
reads connected PR comments (top-level and inline) to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback
